reason: Hypothesis A proposes a physically sound, specific, and testable mechanism where thermal treatment transforms metastable Mg-rich domains into stable intermetallics that form protective oxide layers, improving corrosion and oxidation resistance, with a clear falsification experiment. Hypothesis B, while testable, relies on a less plausible mechanism (Mg precipitation disrupting passivation) and cites evidence (E1) that actually shows good corrosion resistance with intermetallics and protective TiO2 films, undermining its own claim.
